en.另一方个人身份绑定无法验证: The other participant’s identity binding could not be verified.
en.暂时无法读取这间密室的本机数据。原有数据仍保留，请重试。: This room’s local data could not be read. Your existing data is retained. Please try again.

en.以后只需使用通行密钥或生物识别。: After setup, use your passkey or biometrics.
en.使用通行密钥验证身份，日常无需额外记住密码。: Verify your identity with a passkey. No additional password to remember.
en.再次验证通行密钥后在本机查看。: Verify your passkey again to view it on this device.
en.原浏览器可能未在线或未解锁，也可能选择了另一把通行密钥。请确认后重新接入。: The original browser may be offline or locked, or you may have selected a different passkey. Check and try again.
en.凭证密码仅用于本浏览器加密，不上传服务器。: The credential password encrypts data only in this browser and is never uploaded to the server.
en.密室数量已达上限，如需更多请联系客服: Room limit reached. Contact support if you need more rooms.

fr.凭证密码仅用于本浏览器加密，不上传服务器。: Le mot de passe du justificatif chiffre les données uniquement dans ce navigateur et reste hors du serveur.
fr.密室数量已达上限，如需更多请联系客服: Limite de salons atteinte. Contactez le support pour en obtenir davantage.

de.密室数量已达上限，如需更多请联系客服: Raumlimit erreicht. Wende dich an den Support, wenn du weitere Räume benötigst.
